scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:audio
scripts.purity: ! grep -rlE "from '(react|react-native|expo)" src/game || (echo 'src/game must stay free of React/RN/Expo imports' && exit 1)
scripts.test:audio: tsc src/audio/sounds.ts --outDir .probe-audio --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --moduleResolution node && node tools/audiotest/run.js
